prompt:
TESSERA STYLE SHEET
1. Modern editorial paper collage: bold magazine composition, refined 2D motion design, photographed flat under soft room light.
2. One flat block-colour paper ground fills the frame: lime green. The ground is a single unbroken colour.
3. Subjects are black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts with rough white torn-paper edges: objects, machines, buildings, maps, coins, screens, vehicles, anonymous paper hands. Every cutout is a plain, unmarked object: calendar pages, documents, coins, screens and vehicles are blank and unprinted, with no lettering, numerals, symbols, liveries or marks on them.
4. Diagram elements are flat matte paper shapes and ribbons in cream, black, pale yellow, or the ground's contrasting colour, with real paper texture, print dots and small pieces of tape.
5. One consistent light from the upper left; each paper layer casts a small soft shadow.
6. Every surface is matte printed paper reflecting only the room light: cutouts, chips, ribbons and ground all read as photographed paper, with the same flat finish edge to edge. No glow, neon, bloom or halo anywhere.
7. Layout: the headline chip owns the upper third of the frame and stays uncovered; subjects and diagrams occupy the lower two-thirds. When the frame opens on a previous composition, its elements slide off or are covered in the first second and the new headline lands on clear ground.
8. Headline typography: one extra-bold sans-serif in black or cream, printed on a cream or black paper chip, large, with safe margins. Letterforms are accurate, complete and stable from the frame they appear in; the chip is printed once and does not redraw.
9. Motion: elements enter fast with slight overshoot and a stable landing, then hold a clear reading window; one strongest focus at a time; the camera is locked; movement starts on the first frame and a small loop continues at the end; no empty frames.
10. 16:9, exactly 5 seconds, one composition, at most one crisp cut.
11. Identity anchor: rough white torn edges on every cutout; small paper shadow from the upper-left light.

BEAT
Ground: lime green.
Subjects: a torn paper ribbon; a cream paper chip.
Opens on the pointing hand, carried over from the previous shot, which transforms as the action begins.
Action: The previous chip flips away as the pointing hand unrolls into a paper ribbon that tears at its centre and hangs still.
Ends holding on the torn ribbon.
Headline printed on a paper chip: "OR VALUE-DESTRUCTIVE".

ON-SCREEN TEXT: "OR VALUE-DESTRUCTIVE". This string is printed complete and correct from its first visible frame and never changes. It is the only lettering in the frame.

AUDIO: One English narrator, warm, clear, natural, brisk but unhurried, never an advertising shout. Speak the following line exactly once, word for word, beginning on the first frame: "Without it, this becomes financial engineering, not a strategic unlock.". No other dialogue. Light paper-slap and tape sound effects beneath the voice; no music.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] This is a cinematic, modern editorial paper collage style video, photographed as a flat lay under soft, natural room lighting from the upper left. The scene opens on <Picture 1>, featuring a solid lime green paper ground. In the upper third of the frame, a cream-colored paper chip displays the black, extra-bold sans-serif text "CROSS-SELL" in clean, legible lettering. In the lower two-thirds, a black-and-white halftone photographic cutout of a pointing hand (S1) is on the left, and another hand cutout holds a blank white paper chip on the right. Both cutouts feature rough, white torn-paper edges and cast small, soft shadows onto the green ground. At 00:00.000, the movement begins immediately: the "CROSS-SELL" chip and the right-side hand cutout slide quickly off-screen to the right with a slight overshoot. Simultaneously, the pointing hand (S1) transforms, unrolling fluidly into a long, cream-colored paper ribbon that stretches across the lower frame. As the ribbon extends, it tears sharply at its center, leaving two jagged ends that hang still. Simultaneously, a new cream-colored paper chip lands firmly in the upper third of the frame, featuring the black, extra-bold sans-serif text "OR VALUE-DESTRUCTIVE", printed clearly with no misspellings. The camera remains in a Static Shot throughout the 5-second duration. The final second holds on this composition: the "OR VALUE-DESTRUCTIVE" headline chip above the torn cream ribbon on the lime green background. An English narrator (S2), a male with a warm, clear, and natural timbre and a brisk but unhurried speaking rate, says: <d>[English] Without it, this becomes financial engineering, not a strategic unlock.</d>

overall_soundscape: The audio features distinct, tactile foley sounds of paper: a crisp, quick slap as the chips land, the sliding friction of paper on paper, and a sharp, textured ripping sound as the ribbon tears at its center.
